source='''from collections import Counter

def _mode(seq):
    counts = Counter(seq)
    value, count = counts.most_common(1)[0]
    return value, count / len(seq)

def _periodic_lines(grid, axis):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    n = h if axis == 0 else w
    lines = [grid[i] if axis == 0 else [grid[r][i] for r in range(h)] for i in range(n)]
    modes = [_mode(line) for line in lines]
    best = None
    for period in range(2, n + 1):
        for phase in range(period):
            selected = [i for i in range(n) if i % period == phase]
            other = [i for i in range(n) if i % period != phase]
            if len(selected) < 2 or not other:
                continue
            colors = {modes[i][0] for i in selected}
            for color in colors:
                hit = sum(modes[i][0] == color for i in selected)
                miss = sum(modes[i][0] == color for i in other)
                purity = hit / len(selected)
                outside = miss / len(other)
                score = (purity - outside) * len(selected) / n
                # Prefer the smallest period when scores are effectively tied.
                key = (score, -period, purity, len(selected))
                if best is None or key > best[0]:
                    best = (key, period, phase, color)
    if best is None or best[0][0] <= 0:
        return [], None, None
    _, period, phase, color = best
    coords = [i for i in range(n) if i % period == phase and modes[i][0] == color]
    return coords, color, period

def transform(grid):
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    if not g or not g[0]:
        return []
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    rows, row_color, _ = _periodic_lines(g, 0)
    cols, col_color, _ = _periodic_lines(g, 1)
    if row_color is None or col_color is None or row_color != col_color:
        # ARC grid separators use the same color on both axes; choose the most
        # frequent candidate among detected periodic line positions as fallback.
        line_color = row_color if row_color is not None else col_color
    else:
        line_color = row_color
    if line_color is None:
        return [row[:] for row in g]
    # Recompute line positions for the shared separator color using the detected periods.
    # This also removes false periodic positions whose modal color differs.
    rows = [r for r in rows if _mode(g[r])[0] == line_color]
    cols = [c for c in cols if _mode([g[r][c] for r in range(h)])[0] == line_color]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in g]
    specials = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(rows) for j, c in enumerate(cols) if g[r][c] != line_color]
    if not specials:
        return [row[:] for row in g]
    r0, r1 = min(i for i, _ in specials), max(i for i, _ in specials)
    c0, c1 = min(j for _, j in specials), max(j for _, j in specials)
    rr, cc = rows[r0:r1+1], cols[c0:c1+1]
    # The non-grid interior fill is the most common color away from lattice lines.
    interior = [g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in set(rows) and c not in set(cols)]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0] if interior else line_color
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rr)-1):
        row = []

source='''from collections import Counter

def _mode(seq):
    counts = Counter(seq)
    value, count = counts.most_common(1)[0]
    return value, count / len(seq)

def _best_axis(grid, axis, color):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    n = h if axis == 0 else w
    lines = [grid[i] if axis == 0 else [grid[r][i] for r in range(h)] for i in range(n)]
    modes = [_mode(line) for line in lines]
    best = None
    for period in range(2, n + 1):
        for phase in range(period):
            selected = [i for i in range(n) if i % period == phase]
            other = [i for i in range(n) if i % period != phase]
            if len(selected) < 2 or not other:
                continue
            purity = sum(modes[i][0] == color for i in selected) / len(selected)
            outside = sum(modes[i][0] == color for i in other) / len(other)
            score = (purity - outside) * len(selected) / n
            key = (score, -period, purity)
            if best is None or key > best[0]:
                best = (key, period, phase)
    if best is None:
        return 0.0, [], None
    _, period, phase = best
    coords = [i for i in range(n) if i % period == phase and modes[i][0] == color]
    return best[0][0], coords, period

def transform(grid):
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    if not g or not g[0]:
        return []
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    colors = set(v for row in g for v in row)
    scored = []
    for color in colors:
        sr, rows, pr = _best_axis(g, 0, color)
        sc, cols, pc = _best_axis(g, 1, color)
        scored.append((sr + sc, min(sr, sc), color, rows, cols, pr, pc))
    _, _, line_color, rows, cols, _, _ = max(scored, key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in g]
    specials = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(rows) for j, c in enumerate(cols) if g[r][c] != line_color]
    if not specials:
        return [row[:] for row in g]
    r0, r1 = min(i for i, _ in specials), max(i for i, _ in specials)
    c0, c1 = min(j for _, j in specials), max(j for _, j in specials)
    rr, cc = rows[r0:r1+1], cols[c0:c1+1]
    rowset, colset = set(rows), set(cols)
    interior = [g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in rowset and c not in colset]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0] if interior else line_color
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rr)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cc)-1):
            corners = (g[rr[i]][cc[j]], g[rr[i]][cc[j+1]],
                       g[rr[i+1]][cc[j]], g[rr[i+1]][cc[j+1]])
            value = corners[0]
            row.append(value if value != line_color and all(x == value for x in corners) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
